title: Quota Forecast
summary: Projects current usage to the reset date and warns when you'll run out first, so a usage limit isn't hit by surprise.
description: Usage meter that projects the current rate to the reset ("At this pace you'll run out Thu 22 Oct"), turns amber or red on that forecast rather than on raw usage, marks the even-pace point, and says what happens at the limit.
catches: Running out before the reset at the current pace, with the date
Usage ahead of an even pace
Too early in the period to trust a rate: says so
limits: Assumes the average rate so far continues; spikes and seasonality aren't modelled
Numbers are what you pass; it doesn't meter usage
a11y: role=meter with min, max, now and aria-valuetext including the forecast
Forecast text is a polite live region
The even-pace marker is aria-hidden; the message says it in words
stops: Hit the usage limit by surprise
